_comment: Why an example that is run on the website does not work (yet). Shown next to the example. Keys are example ids; update-website maintains this.
feature_demo/anisotropy_barn_lamp: The lamp is not drawn here; the example shows a text that says so. Its material makes pygfx use 13 uniform buffers in the fragment shader (one per texture map), and browsers allow 12. The example asks for more and gets it on wgpu-native. Needs a change in pygfx.
feature_demo/geometry_plane: Plays a video (cockatoo.mp4), which needs PyAV to decode. PyAV (FFmpeg) has no build for Pyodide.
other/sponza_scene: Needs the glTF-Sample-Assets repository (hundreds of MB) next to the examples; the site does not ship it.
validation/validate_view_offset: Draws an offscreen canvas from inside the draw callback of the visible one and waits for the result. In a browser, a draw callback cannot block (no JSPI stack there), so the readback is not available.
